svg.title: One LCW run in a terminal: you ask Claude to add shared lists to a to-do app; Claude plays back what it understood and you approve once; agents build it while a card above the prompt shows the stage, the tasks and each agent with its model and tokens, and two rows below show the mascot, the model, the context and the week's usage against the mark; then a draft pull request opens and the card shows the run finished.

g.text: What is left on the roadmap?
1. Shared lists, so a family or a team can work from one list
Add shared lists to the to-do app
Add shared lists to the to-do app
A large change, so I will run it as an LCW Build. First, a few questions.
How does the to-do API store lists today?
Can the mobile app take live updates?
- Anyone you invite to a list can see and edit it; a link alone opens it read-only.
- Edits show up live for everyone on the list, on the web and on the phone.
- Done means sharing works on both, with tests, and nothing in single lists changes.
Is that what you want? After this I will not ask again until the pull request.
